chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abil Khattab, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sinan, on the authority of Ammar ibn Marwan, on the authority of Jabir, on the authority of Abi Ja’far (peace be upon him) who said:
The perfection of the Hajj pilgrimage depends on visiting the Divine Leader.
ai.seo_question: What is required for the Hajj pilgrimage to be considered complete according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) defines the perfection of Hajj as contingent upon meeting the Imam, a concept deeply rooted in Shia jurisprudence where the Imam serves as the spiritual axis of worship. This narration highlights the theological principle that ritual acts attain their full validity and completeness through connection with the divinely appointed leader, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the Imam's role in guiding the Ummah.
